thread:
sasha: starting release-2026-03-quiet-swap for ingress-runtime v1.7.0. change: route-v4 + prefix-cache improvements. rollout style = quiet-swap + throttle.

deploy-bot: /deploy release-2026-03-quiet-swap ingress-runtime v1.7.0 - initiated by sasha

sasha: short plan:
- deploy with ff.ingress.quiet_swap = shadow (0%)
- ramp pulses: 2% -> 12% -> 40% -> 100% with 90s holds; throttle if autoscaler churn >1.5x
- gates: p95 delta <= +130ms, errors <= +0.45% abs
- regional drain + pin old binary if a region breaches gate for >75s

jules: I'll watch telemetry and keep a quick rollback command ready. dashboards incoming.

infra-bot: preflight: cluster capacity OK, nodegroups healthy, required secrets present.

sasha: setting ff.ingress.quiet_swap 2% now: `flags set ff.ingress.quiet_swap 2 --release=release-2026-03-quiet-swap`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.ingress.quiet_swap -> 2%

jules: 2% soak: p95 +9ms, errors flat. cache priming logs show progress:
```
[2026-03-23T18:04:12Z] prefix-cache: priming chunk 1/3
[2026-03-23T18:04:21Z] route=v4 handshake OK
```

sasha: moving to 12%. `flags set ff.ingress.quiet_swap 12`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.ingress.quiet_swap -> 12%

rachel: 45s into 12% soak: ap-northeast p95 creeping +190ms, small 500 count. recommending regional drain for ap-northeast only and pin old for 1.5h.

jules: agree, do regional drain. command to run: `flags set ff.ingress.quiet_swap --region=ap-northeast 0` and pin TTL 90m.

infra-bot: executing pin: `runtimectl pin ingress-runtime v1.6.9 --pool=ap-northeast --ttl=90m`

deploy-bot: regional flag update: ap-northeast ff.ingress.quiet_swap -> 0%

jules: ap-northeast p95 falling back after drain. global p95 within gate. continuing to 40% outside ap-northeast.

sasha: promoting to 40% excluding ap-northeast: `flags set ff.ingress.quiet_swap 40 --exclude-region=ap-northeast`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.ingress.quiet_swap -> 40% (ap-northeast excluded)

rachel: monitors stable at 40%. leaving pin in ap-northeast; infra to unpin after TTL and post here. I'll file INC-2026-500 minor for tracking.

sasha: wrap-up for GH release notes:
- ingress-runtime v1.7.0 via quiet-swap throttle (2->12->40->100) with regional pin fallback
- safety gates and commands used for regional drain/pin included in runbook
- follow-ups: add region-specific warmup job and a throttle-leash metric to the checklist

jules: thanks team. holding final 100% promote until ap-northeast unpin tomorrow. marking thread to be closed after unpin confirmation. :white_check_mark:
